{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check the arm distribution
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {(df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment').sum()}")
print(f"Number of patients in control arm: {(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control').sum()}")

# Check if arm assignment is associated with severity (confounding)
print("\nArm vs. Severity cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity']))

# Compute response rates by arm
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
treatment_rate = response_rates['treatment']
control_rate = response_rates['control']

treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

print(f"\nResponse rate - treatment: {treatment_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Response rate - control: {control_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}")"}
